Format: psr — piped snapshot rows; shard files are .txt as a reader accommodation, not a format marker
Formatting: Pipe-separated values; LF newlines; Normalized indentation; BOM, C0 controls and DEL are stripped
Compaction:
To ensure single physical lines per row and avoid tokenization boundary effects, normalized LF newlines are strictly encoded with ` 
 `
TreeLegend: name sidx    row_offset  row_meta_end    row_content_begin   row_content_end
Instructions: This is an index manifest of a selective and curated repository snapshot with payload shard files in a custom pipe-separated, LF-delimited container format.
- This manifest includes shard-local 0-based inclusive byte offsets and span widths of each content block in the rows.
- Each shard file contains a header row as the first line, which contains the schema and datatypes of the data rows.
- `.txt` payload files are listed below, found in the same directory as this manifest.
- Rows are single physical lines, and are normalized/sanitized for high SNR and focused analysis.
- Rows are addressed by relative path to Snapshot Root, and each item is assigned a global index (gidx).
- Consume payload data responsibly and in manageable batches over successive inference cycles.
- Use row-level metadata to seek, inform planning and targeted, well-budgeted consumption per cycle.
- Prefer console-based CLI commands for interactive exploration and consumption.
- Never grep the shard files indiscriminately due to context flood hazard
OversizedReason: single record exceeds quota + tolerance; kept whole (atomicity)
